data.text: [00:00]CD1 Track 26
M = Man, A = Anita
[00:04]So, come on then Anita, tell me all about it! Have you found a place for your new restaurant?
[00:10.5]Yes! I’m really excited about it actually. `[00:14]I’m renting a fantastic space … it’s on the ground floor of a big building … in the centre of town … near the school.
[00:23]Oh great … That’s a really good place for a restaurant. `[00:26]What are you going to call it?
[00:27.6]Well, I think I’m going to call it Anita’s ... after me!
[00:32]Why not … ? Yes – Anita’s ... that’s good … And, what type of food are you going to serve?
[00:38]Well, traditional English food, mostly … but with some food from Europe … some Italian and modern French food too … European food, I suppose …
[00:49.7]That sounds good …
[00:51]The thing is, I want the food to be simple, but delicious …
[00:56]Yes …

[00:57]… and I think it’s really important that the prices are reasonable. `[01:01.2]You know, I don’t want it to be really expensive … I want ordinary people to come and to get affordable, good food … I’ve decided that we’re going to keep the menu simple, but change it every two weeks.
[01:14.4]That’s a good idea.
[01:15.5]So, we’re going to have three starters, three main courses and three desserts.
[01:20.8]Mmm, yes … what kind of things, then?
[01:24]In our opening weeks, we’re going to have, as starters: fresh mussels in a garlic sauce, Italian salad and … tomato soup.
[01:34]Lovely!
[01:35]For the main course: cheese and lemon pasta, grilled fish of the day with green beans and roast chicken with potatoes.
[01:44]Mmm …
[01:44.5]And finally, for dessert: chocolate mousse, homemade ice cream and apple pie with cream.
[01:52]Fantastic! You really have got it all planned out! It sounds delicious! And what about the service? Is it going to be waiter service at the table or self-service?

[02:02.9]Ermm … waiter service … I think it’s really important to have friendly waiters who are really efficient. `[02:09.5]There’s nothing worse than bad service in a restaurant … the customers just won’t come back!
[02:15.2]And what are your plans for the décor? I mean, you must have an idea about the kind of atmosphere you want.

[02:21.6]Yes, like the food, I want the place to be quite simple but modern at the same time. `[02:27.7]And we’re going to have music to create a young, lively atmosphere. `[02:32]I’d also like to have paintings on the walls … art by local artists.
[02:36.6]Yes, that’s a nice feature ...
[02:38.5]It’s an extra thing really – to attract more customers. `[02:42.2]Anyway, that’s the plan. We’ll have to see how it goes …
[02:46.6]Well, good luck with it all. I can’t wait to come and try it out!
